items.title: Pay remaining income tax for 2025
items.quote: Die verbleibende Zahlung von 1.624,00 € ist am 28.12.2026 fällig.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar due date for the payment: 28.12.2026. That day is a Monday and not a public holiday in Bremen, so no weekend/holiday shift under §108 Abs.3 AO is needed. Due date = 28.12.2026.

items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: The letter states it was given to the post ('Abgesandt am') on Fri 20.11.2026. Under §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO, a letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after that posting day: 20.11 + 4 days = Tue 24.11.2026 (today), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, so deemed delivery stays on 24.11.2026. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the one-month Einspruch period (§355 AO) begins the following day, 25.11.2026, and under §188 Abs.2 BGB ends on the day of the next month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). That day is a normal working day in Bremen (not a statutory holiday), so under §108 Abs.3 AO no further shift applies. Final due date: 24.12.2026.

warnings: The IBAN printed for the payment, DE62 2900 0000 0066 4010 00, fails the standard IBAN checksum check — verify the bank details (e.g. on a previous original Bescheid or by calling the Finanzamt) before transferring any money.

The letter's own date ('Datum', 19.11.2026) is one day earlier than the stated posting day ('Abgesandt am', 20.11.2026); the Einspruch deadline above is computed from the actual posting day (20.11.2026) as printed, which is the legally relevant day for deemed delivery under §122 Abs.2 AO.

Late payment of the tax after 28.12.2026 triggers monthly late-payment surcharges ('Für jeden angefangenen Monat der Säumnis fallen Zuschläge an.') — this is a cost warning from the letter itself, not evidence of fraud.
